description: § 38(c)(1): the credit cannot exceed net income tax over the greater of the tentative minimum tax or 25% of net regular tax over $25,000. Single, wages $200,000, a $50,000 nonpassive credit (not specified). Taxable income 184,250: tax 1,192.50 + 4,386 + 12,072.50 + 19,416 = $37,067. Line 13 = 25% x 12,067 = 3,016.75; tentative minimum tax 26% x (200,000 − 88,100) = 29,094; line 16 = 37,067 − 29,094 = $7,973 allowed.
